DDInter602.mechanism: Dronedarone may cause dose-related prolongation of the QT interval. DDInter672.mechanism: Coadministration with diuretics may potentiate the risk of hyponatremia associated with the use of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) and serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs).
